name: 井木犴
prompt: Animate exactly the supplied scene as a single continuous six-second shot. Keep its two existing creatures' anatomy, proportions, colors, facial shapes, ornaments, chest jewelry, original limb count, wings if present and detailed flowing tails throughout. Do not recreate or simplify them. The RIGHT creature (井木犴) is the protagonist; the LEFT creature is its silent opponent. Fixed camera, complete bodies within frame, no UI, names, text, borders, bars, added wings or horns. Bird species use their natural beak and keep exactly two legs, never add teeth or mammal hands. 0-2s: the protagonist breathes, calls proudly in its own species' voice and braces its existing limbs or wings. 1.8-3.6s: the protagonist makes one short forceful lunge left, with actual anatomical articulation and weight transfer; winged birds may flap forward and their original feathers and tail follow. The opponent only crouches and reacts, never attacks first. The opponent lowers its near shoulder to the protagonist's mouth height. At 3.8s the protagonist opens its natural jaw or beak around the opponent's shoulder below the neck. At exactly 4.0s close that jaw or beak onto the shoulder and pull briefly, causing the opponent to recoil. Clear visible non-gory contact, no blood or injury. Release at 4.2s, recover original pose by 5.4s, let mane, feathers and tail settle through 6s. The opponent remains silent, only protagonist vocal identity. No speech, music, changes of camera, new designs, morphs, still-frame freeze or image sliding. The whole action and recovery completes in six seconds.
methodRevisionReason: Omni daily quota reached; use a reviewed composed first frame with the available Veo provider for this first candidate.
